Annotators were asked to choose preferred explanation/paraphrase and to judge acceptability (correctness and completeness).

We ask their preferences on 100 randomly sampled instances with respect to the explanations (synthetic e_i vs. iclef-e_i) and paraphrases (original s_f in GYAFC vs. synthetic s_f in E-GYAFC). In addition, we ask for acceptability judgments (whether the paraphrase or explanation are correct and complete) for the preferred paraphrase and separately for e_f.
